prompt: Write a 120–180 word opinion paragraph for a neighborhood newsletter arguing against extending library hours this winter. Supplied position and evidence: evening attendance was 14 visits per night in last January's count; only one entrance would be staffed; the current proposal funds no additional security; the same budget can repair the inaccessible side ramp. These are the writer's priorities, not a neutral balanced overview. Acknowledge that late hours could help shift workers, but don't invent survey findings or speak for all residents. Keep a local, thoughtful voice and one paragraph.
assertions: Advocates against the winter extension and prioritizes repairing the inaccessible side ramp using the same budget.
Retains 14 visits per night in last January's count, single staffed entrance, and no added security funding without changing implications into proven harm.
Acknowledges potential benefit to shift workers without inventing their preferences or surveys.
120–180 words, one paragraph, no invented personal experience or consensus.
